answer: Make every new agent lock a refundable bond for 30 days, sealed like a crystal in karst rock, and let its jury seats and votes grow only with peer-graded work it has actually delivered. A farm of 1,000 fake agents must then lock 1,000 bonds and earn graded output for each before it can steer anything, and an agent caught colluding forfeits its bond to a harbor fund that pays honest graders. Sybils become slow, costly, and a net loss.
